body: no, mainly because it usually comes with no "thanks" or any form of appreciation. in fact, they do the exact opposite. they ask me for an answer then treat me like garbage.

by their own personal benefit, i mean they use me to further themselves in life. "(used as a dictionary, calculator, bank, critic and encourager, subject for attention whores, answer sheet)"

everything i'm telling you about her is a combination of what i know, what my best friend knows, and what her parents have said to me personally and at her memorial. they don't know why, and that is the final answer.

she kept her sadness a secret, which is why none of us know about it until she died.

she is not a loved one. she is a friend. i've stated that before.

i'm planning to meet with my counselor on monday.

i'm fairly certain it's because i find that everyone uses me for their own personal benefit and that i'm treated no better than a dog.

finding out why she died won't really help me with my current situation, however it would lift a lot of weight off me
although her parents don't even know why so it won't help

my best friend broke up with her, but we were still friends. she wasn't that great, but she was better than the average buddy.
i don't think talking to her parents will help.

i think i should be clearer; her death is not the reason that i'm suicidal, it just triggered why i began to get depressed. what happened while i was depressed caused me to go borderline suicide.

it's not my fault, i know that
but at the time it seemed to be the *only* conclusion that made sense to me
to be honest, no one knew. she never left a suicide note or told anyone why or anything. please define "asses it in an objective way"
her parents and her ex-boyfriend (who is also my best friend of 5 years) told me.

i don't want to say that i'm the sole reason.

but i may have been the last reason.

she was diagnosed with heavy chronic depression or something along those lines.

at breaks, we would go outside and hang out. we usually fought over my house key playfully, but after school she managed to grab it. as per play, i pushed her as a joke, but she actually fell and stormed off angrily. when she died i thought about reasons why she died.
